instruction: Enable live translation mode in Writer so the document automatically translates to the reader's preferred language in real-time as they view it.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have a live translation mode that automatically translates documents to different languages in real-time based on reader preferences. This type of functionality requires cloud-based services and multi-user infrastructure that Writer does not provide as a desktop application.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not have live translation mode capabilities
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is appropriate for tasks that cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task requests a non-existent feature
